items.html:
McLaren Smith is a tall right-arm medium-fast bowler and a batsman who was a late inclusion in Bermuda's squad for the Under-19 World Cup in 2008. McLaren was representing Bermuda at the Stanford 20/20 when he was called up due to an injury to Lamar Richardson. Smith's favourite cricketer is Shoaib Akhtar and he is interested in becoming a vet or joining the Royal Marines in the future.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
